Position : Manager of Manufacturing Engineering

Reporting to: Sr. Director of Manufacturing and Manufacturing Engineering

Location : Attica, IN

Date : October 2021

About us:

CD Tech/Trojan Battery- Each founded 100 years ago, joined forces recently to become the world's leading energy storage solution provider and has fueled industry over the past century. How you may ask. . . by focusing on innovative, environmentally friendly energy storage solutions and the people who work hard every day to deliver them to our customers globally. Here, we value the quality and reliability of our products and the integrity with which we provide them to our customers; But the most important thing to us is the professional development of our team members, possibly you, so please, read on -

The job in a nutshell:

Our Manager of Manufacturing Engineering is accountable for ensuring optimization of manufacturing capabilities and the efficiency of capital equipment, direct labor, cost-effectiveness, processes, and quality. You assume ownership of new and existing plant processes projects, especially equipment development and fabrication, to automate existing processes or replace them with the latest technology. Your responsibilities include managing equipment design engineers, overseeing outside contractors for equipment fabrication, working with plant personnel to install equipment, and coordinating with process engineers to facilitate development and final plant acceptance of the equipment and new process. Your task is to improve safety, process, cost, quality, and production methods by directing all ME projects and guiding engineers to resolve problems from root cause analysis to implementation of adequate process controls.

Your Day to Day

- Apply lean manufacturing principles in operations, including process layouts, assembly equipment, and process flows

- Work with operations, maintenance, and quality to identify continuous improvement and cost reduction activities.

- Manage all activities related to the design, modification, and maintenance of tooling, jigs, fixtures for the production machinery

- Work with design engineers during the tooling aspect of the new product introduction phase to ensure products are transitioned quickly into production.

- Recommend design changes or alternatives to assist with manufacturing

- Select and manage suppliers for tools, design services, and build services; act as liaisons between suppliers and the end process.

- Direct activities associated with industrial engineering

- Optimize plant layout through lean methodology and keep process documentation current

- Continuously improve all critical ME documentation

- Own the development of world-class manufacturing workstations

- Evaluate, select, implement, and optimize all equipment

- Implement an operational manufacturing process for all products, with recommendations and documentation

- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for emissions and other environmental concerns

- Troubleshoot productivity, quality, and parts issues in manufacturing, determining root cause, correcting problems, and instituting processes to prevent the problems from recurring

- Implement process improvement initiatives for plant layout, work methods, and equipment

- Document and teach proper routing within the manufacturing process

- Own Capital Projects including requests for equipment, budget, and timeline management

- Drive the "make versus buy" decision-making process during new production projects

- Evaluate all designs and techniques for manufacturability; recommend improvements

- Analyze equipment/product to determine procedures that leverage existing manufacturing or processing methods/facilities

- Support ME projects which require developing specifications, supplier management, purchasing, installation, and qualification of equipment

- Direct the work of designers, technicians, operators, and others on assignments; wear the hat of "local expert" for specific projects/products

- Take part in developing and executing equipment installation and operational qualifications

- Help create and initiate process validations

- Independently evaluate opportunities, initiate related activities, identify solutions, and apply standard engineering analysis tools to assess and select the most suitable.

You,

- Have a demonstratable track record of successfully working within and across the span of the organization, with cross-functional teams, driving change, and implementing new processes to improve process efficiencies in manufacturing significantly

- Embrace the opportunity to lead, mentor, and train 2 - 5 process engineers

- Exemplify strong collaboration and facilitation skills

- Have excellent verbal, and written, communication skills with the ability to present

- Provide technical expertise and leadership while drawing on sound engineering concepts in the resolution of problems

- Are proactive, results-oriented, and have strong attention to detail.

- Can call upon your unmatched organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to make structured decisions.

- Use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

You have,

- A Bachelor's Degree in Manufacturing Engineering or another technical field

- 10+ years of manufacturing experience

- Lean manufacturing/Six Sigma experience

- Proficiency with MS Office Tools (e.g., Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)

- Relocate if necessary (we cover that)

We'd love it if you had:

- Master's Degree in Manufacturing Engineering or a technical field

- 12 - 15 years manufacturing experience

- Battery Industry experience

- Black Belt/Six Sigma Certification

The perks:

- We've got you covered: Medical, Dental, and Vision. Pick from a variety of plans!

- We've all got to plan and save, so use the 401(k), we can teach you how

- We're all about your growth, so we'll reimburse your tuition up to $5k/year

- There's a bunch of time off - here's the breakdown - 15 PTO, 12 holidays

- You'll get access to a Credit Union Membership, Legal Services, and a bunch of Employee Discounts also, Employee Assistance Program

if you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Quality Manager

Xylem

Thomasville, GA, United States

Full Time

Compensation: $90,000 to $130,000 Annually

Reference: Xylem_R46841

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

We are seeking a Quality Manager who is passionate about building high-performing teams, driving operational excellence, and creating a culture where quality is embedded in every process. This role offers the opportunity to lead a talented quality team, shape the site's quality strategy, and play a key role in achieving ISO 9001 certification while supporting a rapidly growing manufacturing operation.

The Quality Manage r will oversee end-to-end manufacturing and fabrication of water filtration equipment, including laser and saw cutting, welding, painting, and final assembly. This role partners closely with the Sr. Quality Manager and the Thomasville Operations Director, working cross-functionally to drive quality excellence and support key business objectives.

Work Environment

- Full-time, onsite position located in Thomasville, Georgia .

- Standard work hours are 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

- Relocation assistance available as applicable.

Quality Manager Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of quality professionals.

- Drive accountability and performance through effective leadership and development practices.

- Foster a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Quality Systems & Compliance

- Develop, implement, and maintain quality procedures, standards, and documentation.

- Lead and support ISO 9001 certification and compliance activities.

- Ensure adherence to customer, regulatory, and company quality requirements.

- Maintain quality records, reports, and supporting documentation.

Quality Performance & Problem Solving

- Monitor and report key quality metrics including Customer DPD, Supplier PPM, COPQ, and NCR performance.

- Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities using structured problem-solving methodologies.

- Manage the non-conformance process and ensure timely resolution of quality issues.

- Drive initiatives to improve process capability and reduce defects.

Customer & Supplier Quality

- Partner with customers to understand quality requirements and address concerns.

- Manage customer returns, corrective actions, and quality-related escalations.

- Monitor supplier performance and lead supplier quality investigations and improvement initiatives.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production teams to improve product quality and manufacturing performance.

- Support engineering change management and process improvements.

- Provide quality leadership for manufacturing processes including fabrication, welding, painting, and final assembly operations.

Continuous Improvement

- Champion continuous improvement initiatives across the facility.

- Utilize data and metrics to identify opportunities and drive measurable improvements in quality and operational performance.

- Promote a culture focused on safety, quality, delivery, and customer satisfaction.

Quality Manager Qualifications:

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field.

- Minimum of 5 years of quality experience within a manufacturing environment.

- Experience with ISO 9001 quality management systems.

- Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills.

- Experience interpreting engineering drawings and GD&T.

- Knowledge of quality auditing, inspections, and manufacturing quality processes.

- Ability to travel as needed.

Preferred

- Previous leadership experience managing quality teams.

- Experience leading ISO 9001 certification efforts.

- ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA) and/or Six Sigma certification.

- Experience supporting fabrication, welding, painting, assembly, or other industrial manufacturing processes.

High-Impact Behaviors

- Servant-leadership mindset

- Strong listening and communication skills

- Ability to balance strategic focus with day-to-day tactical execution

- Proficiency in problem solving and RCCA implementation

- Ability to read and interpret blueprints; GD&T experience required

- Experience in quality inspection and auditing

- Ability to create and revise ISO 9001-compliant documentation

- Ability to travel as needed

Additional Information

- Xylem does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

- Estimated salary range: $90,000-$130,000 plus bonus

- Actual starting pay depends on experience, skills, and location

- Comprehensive benefits package includes:

- Medical, Dental, Vision

- 401(k) with company contribution

- Paid time off and parental leave

- Tuition reimbursement

Thomasville, Georgia is experiencing strong and sustained growth, driven by a revitalized downtown district, ongoing industrial expansion, and an exceptional quality of life. Widely recognized as one of the premier small towns in the South, Thomasville offers an attractive environment for both businesses and professionals seeking long-term opportunity

Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

At Xylem, you'll not only contribute to solving water issues but also have the chance to make a difference through our paid Volunteer Program, Xylem Watermark. We prioritize our employees' well-being through inclusion and belonging as well as our Employee Resource Groups (ERG). Proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity (including disability and veterans) and Affirmative Action workplace, Xylem fosters an inclusive environment free from discrimination or harassment.

About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

Rivian’s Enterprise Systems organization powers the digital backbone of our supply chain, manufacturing, and operations. Our platforms keep factories running, materials and parts flowing, and vehicles moving from planning and production through logistics and delivery.
We are seeking a Senior Manager, Enterprise Systems to lead technology strategy, delivery, and operations for enterprise applications supporting Supply Chain and Manufacturing. This leader will manage high-impact systems used in our factory & warehouse environments.
The ideal candidate combines deep experience with large-scale ERP and enterprise platforms, strong technical judgment, operational leadership, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders around data-driven decisions. They will also help shape the evolution of homegrown applications and responsibly apply AI to improve productivity, automation, and decision support.

Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team responsible for enterprise systems supporting Supply Chain and Manufacturing.

- Own the strategy, roadmap, delivery, reliability, and continuous improvement of applications used across planning, procurement, inventory, production, quality, logistics, and supplier operations.

- Partner closely with plant leadership, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, product, finance, security, data, and executive stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.

- Lead the implementation, integration, and optimization of large-scale ERP and connected enterprise platforms.

- Ensure systems supporting manufacturing-floor operations are reliable, secure, observable, performant, and fit for critical production environments.

- Balance the use of commercial platforms with the development and responsible management of homegrown applications.

- Drive modernization of legacy systems and enterprise workflows through automation, cloud technologies, APIs, event-driven architectures, and data platforms.

- Identify and deliver practical AI use cases, including workflow automation, intelligent operations, forecasting, anomaly detection, and decision-support tools.

- Establish engineering and operational standards covering architecture, testing, cybersecurity, observability, performance, disaster recovery, and service management.

- Communicate technical strategies, risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

- 12+ years of experience delivering enterprise technology solutions, including significant experience with ERP platforms like SAP, Oracle, home-grown at scale.

- 5+ years of experience leading engineering, enterprise applications, or technology operations teams.

- Experience supporting Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or other complex industrial operations.

- Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, application integration, data platforms, APIs, and modern cloud technologies.

- Proven ability to make data-informed decisions and establish effective data governance and operating practices.

- Strong understanding of reliability, cybersecurity, observability, performance, and operational excellence for mission-critical systems.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, prioritization, and people-leadership skills.

Pay Disclosure

Salary Range for this role is $199,300 - $249,100 Illinois based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com .

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 12/10/26

Equal Opportunity
Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.
Candidate Data Privacy and Technology
Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way.

Interview Integrity & AI Policy

Our interview process is designed to evaluate your personal technical foundation, real-time problem-solving logic, and structured capabilities. Therefore, the use of assistive generative AI tools to formulate or deliver your solutions during live interview sessions is not permitted . We care most about how you think — how you make sense of unclear requirements, weigh trade-offs, and explain why you chose one approach over another. We value your unique human perspective, your authenticity, and the journey it takes to reach a solution.

Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

Haydon offers a full suite of premier modern construction solutions. This includes Earthscapes, a full-service landscaping division, Origin, a modeling and design subsidiary, Desert Infrastructure Services, a manhole rehabilitation services subsidiary, and Omni Electric, an electrical and communication infrastructure construction services company. Whether it's the roads we drive on or the buildings we work, shop, learn, play and receive care in, Haydon is the one contractor that serves the entire spectrum of the construction industry - and it does so with heart. The company employs quality, passionate people, innovative technology, an open mind and a can-do attitude to construct projects that serve our entire community. For more information, please visit haydon.com.

SUMMARY

The Director of Quality will develop, implement, and manage the overall quality strategy, consisting of quality assurance and quality control efforts, for construction operations of all Haydon operating entities. The Director will ensure compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, industry and company standards in addition to establishing quality benchmarks, KPI's and the processes and procedures to achieve them. This role is a strategic partner to field leadership, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, compliance and accountability across all phases of construction.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

- Establish, document and continually improve the company wide quality program.

- Evaluates construction operations from a strategic level to ensure that deliverables meet quality, integrity, functionality, and other specifications and requirements

- Ensure alignment with industry best practices, client expectations and legal/regulatory standards i n addition to company standards.

- Collaborates with management and senior staff across departments to develop superior quality standards.

- Coordinate preconstruction quality planning, including mock-ups, first-in-place inspections and constructability review processes and ensure quality expectations are clearly defined in contracts.

- Develop program and process and participate in constructability reviews and design coordination meetings to identify quality impacts early.

- Develops and implements quality standard testing and evaluation processes.

- Facilitates communication among construction , departments, operating entities and leadership.

- Assesses deliverable results and approves recommended changes.

- Reviews quality control documentation such as checklists, logs, and reports for effectiveness, accuracy, and relevance.

- Manages personnel conducting both scheduled and random quality control compliance inspections to verify conformance along with associated reporting structure for associated inspections.

- Systematically reports status of quality control KPI's and operations to executive leadership and, when required, regulatory agencies.

- Evaluate and implement Lean construction processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

- Lead and mentor project QA/QC personnel and other field staff in quality practices.

- Coordinate and conduct quality training programs for Superintendents, Project Engineers, Project Managers, Craftsmen and Trade Partners.

- Provide coaching and corrective feedback on quality related items.

- Develop KPI's to measure and track quality performance and non-conformance trends.

- Present quality reports and root cause analysis findings to executive leadership.

- Drive preventative and corrective action plans to resolve recurring issues found in all phases of construction from preconstruction through warranty.

- Works closely with project teams, preconstruction, safety and commissioning teams to identify and mitigate quality risks.

- Collaborate with marketing in development of project pursuit proposals and marketing materials. Participate in project interviews as necessary.

COMPETENCIES

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

- Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; displays orientation to profitability; demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; aligns work with strategic goals.

- Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; looks for ways to improve and promote quality; applies feedback to improve performance; monitors own work to ensure quality.

- Analytical - Synthesizes complex or diverse information; collects and researches data; uses intuition and experience to complement data; designs workflows and procedures.

- Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

- Judgement - Displays willingness to make decisions; exhibits sound and accurate judgment; supports and explains reasoning for decisions; includes appropriate people in decision-making process; makes timely decisions.

- Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts verbally; expresses ideas and thoughts in written form; exhibits good listening and comprehension; keeps others adequately informed; selects and uses appropriate communication methods.

- Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; makes self-available to staff; provides regular performance feedback; develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; solicits and applies client feedback (internal and external); fosters quality focus in others; improves processes, products and services.; continually works to improve supervisory skills.

- Diversity - Demonstrates knowledge of EEO/AAP policy; shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; educates others on the value of diversity; promotes a harassment-free environment; builds a diverse workforce.

- Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; determines appropriate action beyond guidelines; reports potentially unsafe conditions; uses equipment and materials properly.

QUALIFICATIONS The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Education and/or Experience

10+ years experience in the Construction Industry; 7+ years' experience and/or training in a quality management role or equivalent within a general contracting or construction management environment. . Thorough working knowledge of: construction means and methods, regulatory agency codes, QA/QC processes, familiarity with Lean Construction or other quality methodologies, proficiency in construction management software platforms and a thorough knowledge of commercial construction, safety standards and project management.. Ability to work independently, take initiative, set priorities, and see projects through to completion.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand or walk and to use hands to type, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

This role is at Spirit AeroSystems, Inc. a wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, supporting Spirit’s Commercial Business Units (“Spirit Commercial”). Spirit Commercial designs and builds commercial aerostructures, including for Boeing Commercial Airplanes, one of Boeing’s three business units and the premier manufacturer of commercial jetliners for decades. Spirit Commercial’s core products include fuselages, pylons, nacelles and wing components, with a focus on innovative composite and aluminum manufacturing solutions.

Why Boeing Wichita?
At Boeing Wichita, you'll have the opportunity to lead teams, develop talent, and contribute to the production of aircraft that serve customers around the world.

You'll be part of a team committed to:

- People and Leadership: Building an environment where employees are supported, developed, and empowered to succeed

- Safety and Quality: Maintaining the highest standards in a complex manufacturing environment

- Operational Excellence: Improving processes, solving challenges, and delivering on production commitments

- Teamwork and Innovation: Collaborating across functions to achieve shared goals and strengthen manufacturing performance

- The Future of Aerospace: Contributing to the people, processes, and products that keep the world connected

At Boeing Wichita, our Operations teams transform complex manufacturing plans into high-quality aerospace products. We are seeking people-focused leaders who can inspire production teams, execute production schedules, solve operational challenges, and drive performance across safety, quality, and delivery.

As a Front Line Leader in Fabrication located in Wichita, Kansas , you will lead the frontline manufacturing teams that produce precision components, details, and assemblies that support complex aircraft programs. You will play a vital role in developing employees, strengthening team performance, and ensuring production objectives are achieved in a safe, high-quality, and efficient environment.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day by helping shape our culture, develop employees, and drive performance while maintaining high quality and safety standards.

Position Responsibilities:

- Manages employees performing activities in multiple manufacturing disciplines

- Develop and lead strategies to improve on-time delivery, cost efficiency, safety, quality, and productivity through continuous improvement initiatives

- Determine future staffing needs, develop team capabilities, and conduct performance reviews for subordinates

- Collaborate with various support functions on new or changing statements of work and communicate effectively with internal customers to expedite the fabrication of details and assemblies

- Apply process management and improvement techniques, using problem-solving skills and analytical abilities to develop innovative and efficient solutions to fabrication challenges

- Facilitate work teams, provide training, and interface with internal organizations and external customers for project planning, problem resolution, and process improvement

- Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Customer teams to resolve issues and improve performance

- Support employee development through coaching, mentoring, and performance management

- Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

- 5+ years of experience in Aerospace, Aviation, or Machining, including a manufacturing environment

- 5+ years of leadership or management experience

- Prior experience working with cross-functional groups

- Flexibility to work on 2nd, 3rd, or alternative work week shifts

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, manufacturing, or business-related field

- Experience leading projects while managing schedules, budgets, and operational objectives

- Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes

- Experience with SAP and Microsoft Office Suite

- Experience working within a unionized manufacturing environment and managing collective bargaining agreements

This Is Your Moment to Lead:
Great production leaders do more than meet schedules. They develop people, build trust, solve problems, and create an environment where teams can perform at their best.

If you're ready to lead from the front, develop talent, and make a meaningful impact on aircraft production, we want to hear from you!

Help build the future of flight by joining our team!

Shift Information:

Boeing Wichita operates across first, second, and third shifts. Available positions and assigned shifts depend on approved business requirements.

Candidates may indicate their preferred shift and any additional shifts they are willing to consider. Final shift assignments will align with the needs of the business and the approved position.

Conflict of Interest:

Successful candidates must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Drug Free Workplace:
We are a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

Pay & Benefits:
We strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

We also provide eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Role Description & Responsibilities
We are seeking a visionary and strategic leader to drive the development and deployment of next-generation AI Factory solutions within our High-Tech Industry organization.
As the AI Infrastructure Industry Expert , you will define and deliver transformative, data-driven experiences by leveraging artificial intelligence, machine learning, virtual twins, Model-Based Systems Engineering and the 3DEXPERIENCE Platform. Your mission is to help high-tech manufacturers . deliver configurable, traceable, and simulation-ready AI factory designs, to reduce Time to first token and increase Tokens per Watt.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and execution—bridging business needs with cutting-edge technology to create scalable, high-value industrial solutions.
We are looking to fill this position in San Francisco / Santa Clara, CA.
Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:
· Develop the strategic roadmap for AI-enabled manufacturing transformation.
· Identify, prioritize, and develop high-impact AI use cases across production, operations, and supply chain
· Partner closely with R&D, Services, Sales, and industrial stakeholders to align innovation with market opportunities
· Ensure seamless integration across the broader Dassault Systèmes solution portfolio.
· Establish solution frameworks that meet scalability, security, and interoperability requirements
· Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and best practices.
· Oversee Proofs of Value (PoVs) to validate business impact and accelerate adoption.
· Develop compelling value propositions tailored to both executive stakeholders and engineering teams
· Serve as a thought leader by representing Dassault Systèmes at industry conferences, publications, and technical forums
· Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning
· Champion internal initiatives such as hackathons, AI upskilling, and knowledge-sharing programs
· Promote ethical AI practices and responsible innovation across the organization

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business or a related field, MBA a plus

- 8+ years’ experience in technical consulting, including leading AI, industrial automation or smart manufacturing initiatives

- Strong knowledge and understanding of the AI Factories and high-tech domain

- Demonstrated success in managing digital transformation projects

- Experience working with executive-level stakeholders and influencing strategic business decisions

- Ability to demonstrate leadership to both internal and external teams

- Exposure to Dassault Systèmes Product Portfolio a plus

- Effective Relationship Building Skills

- Strong Communication Skills, both written and verbal

Position Summary

Are you passionate about leading the frontline defense against today's most sophisticated cyber threats – both known and unknown? Do you want to own and evolve an advanced operational threat defense capability, grounded in evidence-based knowledge of the threat landscape, that safeguards client data and is delivered to some of the world's leading organizations – not just as a project, but as an ongoing, mission-critical service? Are you energized by building high-performing teams, driving strategy for a growing service line, and being accountable for the outcomes that keep our clients secure?

If yes, then Deloitte's Cyber Detect and Respond team could be the place for you! Deloitte's Cyber Detect and Respond business is focused on enabling change to expand the scope of threat monitoring and managed Security Operations Center (SOC) services, helping organizations adapt to emerging infrastructural change and deliver lasting impact. Running our industry-leading managed services requires significant expertise, sound business judgment, and strong leadership of diverse, distributed teams.

We collaborate with teams from across our organization to bring the full breadth of Deloitte – its commercial and public sector expertise – to best support our clients. Our aspiration is to be the premier integrated services provider in helping to transform the cyber security services marketplace. Our team is client focused and mission driven. As an Associate Vice President (AVP) in Cyber Detect and Respond, you will own the delivery, strategy, and financial performance of managed SOC engagements, leading teams of managers and analysts – onshore and offshore – to solve some of today's toughest cybersecurity and organizational challenges.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AVP, Engineering Managed Services on the Cyber Detect and Respond team, you will be responsible for…

- Lead end-to-end managed Security Operations Center (SOC) delivery for assigned clients, including service-level agreement performance, service quality, protection of sensitive client data, and continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities
- Translate current threat intelligence into detection logic, use cases, response playbooks, and client reporting; expand coverage for known and novel threats through User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and anomaly-based detection
- Set and execute roadmaps for Cyber Detect and Respond services, including delivery-model evolution, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) modernization, cloud migrations, automation, and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capabilities
- Lead managers and analysts across onshore and offshore teams; oversee performance, development, escalation management, and complex incident investigation, mitigation, and remediation
- Own engagement financial performance and governance, including margin, utilization, staffing, forecasting, executive reporting, account planning, client relationships, growth opportunities, and Deloitte engagement-management requirements

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to lead projects or workstreams
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

- Deloitte’s Cyber Operate team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure.Vigilant.Resilient.™ cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions.

Qualifications

Required:

- 10+ years of experience in security monitoring, security engineering, or security analytics, including experience leading managed Security Operations Center (SOC) or detection and response services
- 10+ years of experience leading cybersecurity managed-services delivery, Security Operations Center operations, or cybersecurity transformation programs with responsibility for client delivery, staffing, financial management, executive reporting, account planning, solution design, proposal development, pricing, or contracting
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, information security, mathematics, decision sciences, risk management, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or industrial engineering
- Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

- Experience building or scaling a cybersecurity service-delivery model, including workforce planning across onshore and offshore teams
- Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) certification
- Experience with one or more of the following technologies: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Intrusion Detection Systems/Intrusion Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), proxy platforms, Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), anti-virus tools, sandboxing, network- and host-based firewalls, penetration-testing tools, or technologies used to identify Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs)
- Experience operationalizing threat intelligence by converting evidence-based research on existing and emerging threats into detection content, use cases, and client advisories
- Experience operating on-premises and cloud-based SIEM environments and Security Operations Center processes, including User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capabilities
- Experience applying data-protection practices throughout security detection and investigation activities, and experience investigating network probing/scanning, Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks, and malicious-code activity across network infrastructure devices and protocols

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is 163,400 to 322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. • Strong skills in statistics and computer software.
• Knowledge of product conformity and certification requirements.
• Understanding of airworthiness regulations.

Houston, Texas, United States · Forward Deployed Engineering · Employment Type: Full-Time
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI

C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas & Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Process Optimization/Network Optimization.

Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end-to-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.

The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Leaders work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings significant hands-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.

The ISL, Oil, Gas & Chemical - Process Optimization/Network Optimization should have hands-on experience in midstream or downstream oil & gas operations or engineering, including pipelines, compressor stations, pumps, terminals, tanks, and SCADA systems, with ownership of throughput, hydraulics, integrity, reliability, scheduling, or operating constraints.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.

- Serve as the primary customer-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.

- Identify and quantify high-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.

- Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.

- Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale-out.

- Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.

- Lead cross-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.

- Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.

- Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.

- Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.

- Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.

- Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.

- Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.

- Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.

- 7+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.

- Deep experience in one or more asset-intensive industries, including high-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.

- Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.

- Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.

- Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.

- Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.

- Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.

- Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.

- Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.

- Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to travel to customer locations as required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.

- Hands-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.

- Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.

- Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.

- Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.

- Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.

Introduction to the job
ASML is seeking an experienced technical project manager to play a key role in bringing critical modules from development into high‑volume manufacturing. In this position, you will drive sourcing, industrialization, and manufacturing readiness in line with the EUV Source product roadmap.

The role is part of Strategic Sourcing & Procurement (SS&P) within Supplier Collaboration & Quality (SC&Q) and represents the sourcing perspective in a cross‑functional Module Delivery Unit. SC&Q within ASML is responsible for ensuring that new parts and products are successfully introduced into the supply chain and scaled for reliable, cost‑effective production.

Working closely with colleagues from Development & Engineering, Quality, Logistics, and our global supply chain partners, you will help translate product innovations into manufacturable solutions. This includes managing supply chain requirements, coordinating product introductions and phase‑outs, handling complex parts and engineering changes, and ensuring material and infrastructure readiness throughout the product lifecycle.

To be successful, you combine strong commercial insight with hands‑on experience in supplier management and have a proven track record of leading suppliers from New Product Introduction (NPI) into stable high‑volume manufacturing.

Position Summary

Are you passionate about shaping the cyber and organizational risk posture of leading companies at enterprise scale? Do you thrive on building and leading high-performing teams across multiple cyber domains and engagements? Are you energized by turning rapidly changing threats and operating environments into a clear strategy, and by developing the next generation of cyber leaders to deliver it?

If yes, then Deloitte's Cyber Foundry team could be the place for you! Transparency, innovation, collaboration, sustainability: these are the hallmark issues shaping cyber initiatives today. Deloitte's Foundry business, our Cyber as a Service (CyaaS) offering, is passionate about making an impact with lasting change. Delivering our industry-leading services requires fresh thinking and a creative approach. We collaborate with teams from across our organization to bring the full breadth of Deloitte, across various workstreams, to best support our clients. Our aspiration is to be the premier integrated services provider in helping to transform the cyber security services marketplace. Managing our industry-leading services requires significant expertise, varied experience, and continued focus on creative approaches.

Our team is client focused and mission driven. As an Associate Vice President (AVP) in Cyber Foundry, you will provide senior leadership to our diverse teams of passionate and expert professionals, including Managers, technical leads, and analysts, to help solve some of today's toughest cybersecurity and organizational challenges, enabling our clients to grow the business while managing evolving risk across a portfolio of engagements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Associate Vice President, Engineering Managed Services on the Cyber Foundry team, you will be responsible for providing senior leadership across a portfolio of cyber operations and managed security services engagements.

- Lead a portfolio of cyber operations and managed security services engagements, including delivery, financial forecasting, margin management, resource planning, service-level agreement performance, and engagement governance
- Serve as the senior escalation point and trusted advisor to client chief information security officers, chief information officers, and other executives for security incidents, strategic risk decisions, executive briefings, and post-incident reviews
- Set operational and technical strategy across security operations and incident response, endpoint security, application security, threat and vulnerability management, identity and access management, and network security
- Lead, coach, and develop Managers, technical leads, and analysts across engagements and geographies; oversee engagement onboarding, transitions, reporting, and escalation management
- Drive Cyber Foundry practice growth through sales pursuits, request for proposal responses, client solution presentations, vendor relationships, and adoption of cybersecurity methodologies, architectures, and technologies

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to lead projects or workstreams
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber Operate team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation, and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive Secure.Vigilant.Resilient.™ cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions.

Qualifications

Required:
- 10+ years of experience in Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services, or Cyber Operations, including 5+ years of people-leadership experience across engagements
- 5+ years of experience with security technologies, including threat and vulnerability management, Security Operations Center operations, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Intrusion Detection Systems/Intrusion Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), proxies, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Endpoint Detection and Response/Extended Detection and Response (EDR/XDR), antivirus, sandboxing, network- and host-based firewalls, threat intelligence, and penetration testing
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, information security, mathematics, decision sciences, risk management, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or industrial engineering
- Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:
- One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
-Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification
- Experience building or scaling a Managed Security Services or Cyber Operations practice, including capability build-out and service maturity roadmaps
- Experience leading sales pursuits, request for proposal (RFP) responses, and solution development for cyber managed services engagements
- Experience translating technical security findings into client recommendations and executive presentations
- Experience coaching and mentoring Managers into senior leadership roles
- Experience coordinating activities across multiple cyber workstreams and engagements

Description

About the role:
Shape the future of Manufacturing, allowing AI systems to integrate with physical devices, including robots, vehicles and machines, using a broad range of sensors and actuators to perceive, decide and act in real-world environments.
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must‑have insights, market predictions, and best practices for world‑leading organizations.
A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights sector, establishing credibility at local, regional, and global levels. They produce pragmatic and provocative research that clients use to advance key objectives and act as trusted advisors through client interactions, meetings, briefings, and conference engagements.
What you will do:

- Create innovative, thought-provoking, highly leveraged research content for Manufacturing CIOs and AI Leaders, their teams and stakeholders

- Develop new research ideas and offer actionable approaches to client needs

- Analyze client challenges to identify root causes and reframe thinking

- Demonstrate thought leadership around the future of manufacturing; ecosystems, geopolitics, technologies, vendors and the regulations impacting it; the role of data; required business capabilities; and help shape research positions across analyst teams

- Research and predict manufacturing market vendors and trends to provide actionable insights, e.g. Magic Quadrants, Critical Capabilities, Strategic Roadmaps

- Assist Manufacturers in their digitalization and AI Journeys by providing guidance on readiness, strategy, use case prioritization, business case, architecture, design and vendor selection

- Bring independent insights that influence research agendas and help clients make informed, unbiased decisions

- Collaborate with Team Managers and Research Cohort Leads to align stakeholders and drive high‑impact outcomes

- Pivot into adjacent research areas as client demand evolves and boundaries between industries and technologies blur

- Provide actionable client advice via virtual or in‑person interactions

- Create and deliver high‑value presentations for Gartner events and client briefings

- Support Research and Sales by representing the voice of the market and driving client engagement

- Peer‑review research content to ensure quality and timeliness

- Build credibility as an industry expert representing Gartner research and methodology

- Participate in innovation and research discussions with peers

- Identify and improve research processes

- Mentor and coach junior team members

- Be client‑centric and encourage regular engagement with Gartner research

What you will need :
12+ years of experience in Manufacturing IT, with deep expertise in manufacturing core systems and preferably deterministic, production-grade AI use cases. Proven background in the design, deployment, and integration of:

- Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), including orchestration of shop-floor processes

- IIoT (Industrial IoT)

- Enterprise integrations across MES, ERP, Data Warehouses, PLM, and Quality systems

- Deterministic AI and analytics applications in manufacturing, including:

- Decision-support systems

- Rules-based optimization and scheduling

- Domain-specific large models (DSLMs) applied to manufacturing operations

- Computer vision for quality inspection and defect detection

- Edge computing architectures enabling low-latency, high-reliability manufacturing use cases

- Robotics and automation integration within controlled, safety-critical manufacturing environments

- Analysis and improvements of manufacturing/operations data using AIoT, Data Platforms, Digital Twins/Threads

- Deep knowledge of the competitive global landscape of the industrial and AI SW and service market

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; graduate degree preferred

- Executive presence and ability to establish credibility quickly

- Strong collaboration and organizational skills

- High‑quality research, writing, analytical, and presentation skills

- Ability to explain complex concepts simply

- Comfort presenting to internal and external clients at various scales

- Strong business and financial acumen

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multicultural environment

- Learning agility and ability to navigate matrixed environments

- Ability to represent Gartner’s research methodology effectively

- Willingness to travel up to 25%

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
